title: Broker endpoint resolution uses incorrect hostname in error messages
description: When the broker is accessed via a hostname that resolves to an IP address (172.28.0.5), connection errors report the IP instead of the original hostname, making debugging confusing. The error message shows 'jentic-one:8100' was transformed to '172.28.0.5:8100' but the agent was not informed of this transformation.
reproduction_steps: Configure broker endpoint as a hostname (e.g., jentic-one:8100)
Attempt to make a proxied request when broker is not accessible at that hostname
expected_behavior: Error message should either: (1) show the original hostname used, or (2) explain that the hostname resolved to an IP and provide both for debugging context.
actual_behavior: Error message shows only the resolved IP address (172.28.0.5:8100), making it unclear what the original endpoint was.
evidence: Error: 'Get "http://jentic-one:8100/http://test-api:8080/get": dial tcp 172.28.0.5:8100: connect: connection refused'
